title: Lovely counter
body: I used to give my starting date to chatgpt and ask him how long I stopped smoking and drinking. But with Days Since I can see it whenever I want. It’s a simple but practical app. It has lots of features like faceID so everything stays private, you can choose between hours, days, weeks, months and years. It has a simple reset button for if you fell again, it has different colors for habits and many different app logo’s to choose from. I suggest Days Since to keep track of your victories.
